content:
**Hardened** is a material mod in *Fallout 76*.

When applied to a armor pieces, it improves Damage and Energy Resistance.

Armor modifications will modify an existing armor, and any modifications previously equipped on the armor will be destroyed, not unequipped. Loose mods cannot be crafted. For modifications unlocked through scrapping, the corresponding armor must be scrapped in order to learn how to craft it.
